items.quote: Haiel assisted with the team's recovery after a major project setback.
She managed media interviews and press conferences for her unit.
She worked alongside the team that led the policy review on housing grants.
She drove the policy review on housing grants for the whole division.
Haiel managed long-term strategy for the sector for her unit.
She managed the redesign of the citizen journey for permits for her unit.
She led community engagement on the estate renewal plan across the department.
